verdict.rationale: mParticle documents Data Privacy Controls and Consent Filters. Consent state drives GDPR consent and CCPA data-sale opt-out, and forwarding rules can block data when an opt-out is present. This gives a real opt-out mechanism for tracked end users, but it governs the data mParticle collects on a customer's behalf. Nothing shows a user or operator can opt out of mParticle's own product telemetry or usage tracking. Missing for 10: documented opt-out of mParticle's own product/SDK telemetry, details of SDK-level opt-out behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.
